facts.text: The Branson Beach Estate sits on a dramatic outcrop at the northeast tip of Moskito Island, with elevated sea views.
facts.excerpt: Perched on a dramatic outcrop demanding elevated sea views at the northeast tip of Moskito Island, The Branson Beach Estate

facts.text: The Branson Beach Estate is about two miles from Necker Island.
facts.excerpt: Just two miles from Necker Island, The Branson Beach Estate is located on Moskito Island in the British Virgin Islands

facts.text: Moskito Island is approximately 30 minutes by boat from Tortola, the nearest international airport.
facts.excerpt: approximately 30 minutes by boat from Tortola, the nearest international airport

facts.text: The estate is made up of three standalone villas connected by elevated wooden walkways.
facts.excerpt: The estate is made up of three spectacular standalone villas, connected by elevated wooden walkways

facts.text: The estate has its own private beach.
facts.excerpt: It even has its own private beach

facts.text: The estate's three villas can be booked individually or all together on an exclusive basis, all year round.
facts.excerpt: The estate's three villas can be booked individually or all together on an exclusive basis, all year round.

facts.text: The three villas are Headland House, Mangrove Villa and Beach Villa.
facts.excerpt: The estate’s three villas - Headland House, Mangrove Villa and Beach Villa

facts.text: The estate's resident chef plans menus tailored to each guest's needs and tastes, from local Caribbean specialities to international dishes.
facts.excerpt: From local Caribbean specialities to international dishes, each menu is tailormade specifically to guests needs and tastes.

facts.text: The estate offers walking trails and two tennis courts.
facts.excerpt: beautiful walking trails, two tennis courts and masses more

facts.text: The estate's team helps organise events, from intimate ceremonies to milestone birthdays.
facts.excerpt: Our expert team is on hand to help you organise your event, from intimate ceremonies to milestone birthdays and everything in between.

facts.text: The villas are in a Balinese style.
facts.excerpt: standalone Balinese-style villas, looking out at the private beach and sea

facts.text: Headland House has sea views from all bedrooms.
facts.excerpt: Sea views from all bedrooms

facts.text: Headland House has a wraparound infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Wraparound infinity pool

facts.text: Beach Villa has direct access to a private sandy beach.
facts.excerpt: Direct access to private sandy beach

facts.text: Mangrove Villa is nestled among mangrove trees and faces east towards Necker Island and Virgin Gorda.
facts.excerpt: Nestled among mangrove trees and connected to Beach Villa and Headland House via wooden walkways, Mangrove Villa faces east towards Necker Island and the island of Virgin Gorda.

facts.text: Headland House sits at the heart of The Branson Beach Estate.
facts.excerpt: this luxurious villa sits at the very heart of The Branson Beach Estate

facts.text: Beach Villa sits in a sheltered position just above a sandy beach, with views to the Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: Beach Villa takes up an enviable sheltered position just above a sandy beach with views out to the Caribbean Sea and up to Headland House.

facts.text: The estate is next to Moskito Island's communal recreational facilities.

facts.text: Moskito Island has grass tennis courts with stadium seating.
